##### Release notes for Yocto-5.0.21 (Scarthgap)

Expat has been updated to v2.8.3 to fix CVEs for which the patches were too complex to backport.

###### Security Fixes in Yocto-5.0.21

- alsa-lib: Fix CVE-2026-56109

- apt: Ignore CVE-2011-3374

- binutils: Fix CVE-2025-1147, CVE-2025-8224, CVE-2026-3441, CVE-2026-3442, CVE-2026-4647, CVE-2026-15003 and CVE-2026-18220

- bison: Fix CVE-2026-56389

- busybox: Fix CVE-2024-58251

- cpio: Fix CVE-2026-66484 and CVE-2026-66485

- curl: Fix CVE-2026-13608

- curl: Ignore CVE-2026-8458 and CVE-2026-82209

- expat: Ignore CVE-2026-72522

- glib-2.0: Fix CVE-2026-58015

- glibc: Fix CVE-2026-5435 and CVE-2026-6238

- gnutls: Fix CVE-2026-5419, CVE-2026-33845, CVE-2026-33846, CVE-2026-42010 and CVE-2026-42011

- gnutls: Ignore CVE-2026-1584

- go: Fix CVE-2026-39823
